metadata.description: Deterministic public repository seed fixture for offline demonstration and reproducible evaluation without network access or GitHub tokens.

codeowners:
# Paths whose contents EXECUTE with this repository's credentials, rather than
# merely being tested by CI.
#
# Why this is the control and the workflow check is not: for a merge-queue run
# the workflow is read from the queue branch, which carries the pull request's
# own changes — so a fork can edit the step that is supposed to refuse it. The
# CODEOWNERS that applies to a pull request is always the one on the BASE
# branch ("the pull request will use the CODEOWNERS file from that branch in
# the upstream repository"), so a fork cannot supply the rules that judge it.
#
# This file only REQUESTS review on its own. It blocks merging only if the
# ruleset also enables "Require review from Code Owners" — which is the point,
# and has to be turned on separately.
#
# /tests/ and /flow.sh are deliberately not listed. Both execute, but a
# contributor has to be able to add a test and adjust how it runs; that exposure
# is handled by the queue running with persist-credentials off and no registry
# credential, not by review.

/build/          @FalkorDB/falkordb-core
/.github/        @FalkorDB/falkordb-core

# Listed so weakening the rules above needs the same approval they do.
/CODEOWNERS      @FalkorDB/falkordb-core
